institutions.name: Hang Seng University of Hong Kong

requirement.applicantContext: First-year entry with the full IB Diploma, for applicants with international qualifications regardless of local status.
requirement.subjectNotes: Present three HL and three SL subjects. The HL subjects must contribute at least 12 points in total.
requirement.conditions: Complete the full IB Diploma and satisfy the English language and applicable programme requirements. The actuarial programme also specifies a Mathematics grade.

source.title: HSUHK · International qualifications for Year 1
source.evidence: 12 points or above to be obtained from subjects at Higher Level

program.name: Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Actuarial Studies and Insurance

requirement.applicantContext: Additional IB subject condition for Year 1 Actuarial Studies and Insurance.
requirement.subjectNotes: Attain at least grade 5 in IB Mathematics at either SL or HL.
requirement.conditions: The university-wide IB Diploma threshold also applies. The programme publishes a Mathematics grade and gives no separate programme total.

source.title: HSUHK · International qualifications for Year 1
source.evidence: Grade 5 or above in Standard Level (SL) or Higher Level (HL) Mathematics
